item.title: Scottish Parliament Approves £68 Billion Budget for 2026 to 27
item.description: MSPs have approved a £68 billion Scottish Budget for 2026 to 27, including record funding for health and social care and continued cost of living support for households across Scotland.The post Scottish Parliament Approves £68 Billion Budget for 2026 to 27 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: MSP Warns of Postcode Lottery Blocking Care Experienced Young People From Construction Trades
item.description: Ariane Burgess has warned that care experienced young people in the Highlands and Islands are being locked out of key construction trades due to a lack of local training courses, calling for urgent action to end what she described as a postcode lottery.The post MSP Warns of Postcode Lottery Blocking Care Experienced Young People From Construction Trades appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Dedicated Vessel Secured to Protect Ferry Services During Western Isles HVDC Project
item.description: A dedicated vessel has been secured to support construction of the Western Isles HVDC link, with assurances that lifeline ferry services between Stornoway and Ullapool will be protected throughout the project.The post Dedicated Vessel Secured to Protect Ferry Services During Western Isles HVDC Project appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Unite Warns of Irreversible Cuts to Health and Social Care
item.description: Unite has warned that without urgent investment, health and social care services face irreversible cuts as Integration Joint Boards struggle to meet an almost £450 million funding gap. The post Unite Warns of Irreversible Cuts to Health and Social Care appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Leadbitter Accuses UK Government of Inflicting Austerity on Moray
item.description: Graham Leadbitter has accused the UK Government of inflicting further austerity on Moray after the ending of Shared Prosperity Funding, warning that local jobs and projects will be lost.The post Leadbitter Accuses UK Government of Inflicting Austerity on Moray appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Light Filled Eco Home by The Dunes in Findhorn
item.description: Located in The Park Eco Village in Findhorn, 562 West Whins is a Makar built one bedroom eco home with vaulted ceilings, floor to ceiling windows and private garden, just minutes from dunes and Moray Firth beaches.The post A Light Filled Eco Home by The Dunes in Findhorn appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Landlord Sought for Crown Inn in Stornoway
item.description: Star Pubs is seeking a new landlord for The Crown Inn in Stornoway, with the 16 bedroom hotel and pub marketed as a potential £1.1 million turnover opportunity in the heart of the Outer Hebrides. The post New Landlord Sought for Crown Inn in Stornoway appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: ALBA Candidates Urge UK Minister to Back Haventus Ardersier Project
item.description: ALBA Party candidates in the Highlands and Islands have written to the UK Energy Minister urging full backing for the Haventus Ardersier project, which is expected to support around 1,500 jobs.The post ALBA Candidates Urge UK Minister to Back Haventus Ardersier Project appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £1 Million Social Programme Announced Ahead of 2027 Tour De France Grand Départ
item.description: A £1 million social impact programme has been launched to ensure Scotland secures a lasting legacy from hosting the 2027 Tour de France Grand Départ, with projects aimed at boosting participation and wellbeing nationwide.The post £1 Million Social Programme Announced Ahead of 2027 Tour De France Grand Départ appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Passes Budget With NHS and Cost Of Living at its Core
item.description: MSPs have passed the Scottish Budget, with the SNP saying record NHS funding and expanded cost of living support show it is focused on Scotland’s priorities ahead of May’s election.The post SNP Passes Budget With NHS and Cost Of Living at its Core appeared first on The Highland Times.
